T: Fish for the colony, dancing shoes optional.
D: An emperor penguin who can't sing but can tap dance sets out to find out why the fish are disappearing.
P: Serve the fish when Mumble brings food back for the whole colony.
S: the fish the whole colony depends on
Tinned sardines mashed with lemon and pepper, spread on buttered toast and grilled for a minute until hot.
Iceberg lettuce cut into wedges with creamy blue cheese dressing, crispy bacon and chopped tomato.
Choux pastry beaten with cheddar, piped into small balls and baked until puffed, dusted white with parmesan.
M: the fish Mumble brings back to the colony
White fish and prawns in a parsley white sauce, topped with buttery mash and baked until golden.
the humans' base on the ice
Beef mince and beans simmered with onion, cumin, chilli and tomato for an hour, with rice and sour cream.
W: snow-white and pink, like the Antarctic sky
Desiccated coconut mixed with condensed milk and icing sugar, half tinted pink, pressed in layers and set.

s.note: the fish the whole colony depends on
s.how: Drain 2 tins sardines (220g total) and mash with the juice of half a lemon and black pepper. Toast 4 slices white bread, butter them, spread with the sardines and grill for 1 minute until hot. Cut into fingers.

Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into 4 wedges. Mash 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with lemon and pepper. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with bacon and 1 diced tomato.

m.note: the fish Mumble brings back to the colony
m.how: Poach 600g white fish in 500ml milk for 5 minutes and flake. Make a sauce with 40g butter, 3 tbsp flour and the poaching milk, add 200g peeled prawns and chopped parsley, and pour into a dish with the fish. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 40g butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: snow-white and pink, like the Antarctic sky
w.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk and 250g icing sugar into a stiff paste. Press half into a lined 20cm tin, tint the rest pink with a drop of colouring and press on top. Chill 2 hours until firm and cut into squares.

d.note: penguins live on krill, and krill is pink
d.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream, 250g strawberries and 400ml milk until thick and pink. Pour into 4 glasses and top with whipped cream. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
